services.title: Bond cleans
services.short: End of lease cleaning done thoroughly, so you can hand back the keys with confidence.
services.long: Moving out is stressful enough. We clean the property top to bottom so it's ready for the final inspection.
points: End of lease and move-out cleans
Add oven, window and carpet cleaning

services.title: Regular house cleans
services.short: Weekly, fortnightly or monthly cleans to keep the house on top of things.
services.long: Come home to a clean house without giving up your weekend. Pick weekly, fortnightly or monthly visits to suit your household.

services.title: Office & commercial
services.short: Reliable cleaning for offices and workplaces around the Bay.
services.long: A clean workplace makes a good impression. We clean offices and commercial spaces on a schedule that suits your business.

services.title: Oven cleaning
services.short: Baked-on grease and grime lifted from your oven.
services.long: Oven cleaning is one of the jobs most people put off. Add it to a bond clean or book it on its own.
points: Book on its own or as an add-on

services.title: Window cleaning
services.short: Clear, streak-free windows to let the light back in.
services.long: Salt air and dust build up quickly on the coast. We clean windows so your view is clear again.

services.title: Carpet cleaning
services.short: Freshen up carpets as part of a bond clean or on their own.
services.long: Carpet cleaning is often needed at the end of a lease. Ask us to include it when you book.
